title: Side effects happen once
design_ref: Side effects: exactly once where it matters
purpose: Make the external Git host lose its answer after it has already made a change, which is the case a retry cannot tell from a failure. Show first what an unprotected tool does, then the same fault against the protected tools, then a tool that cannot be protected.

steps.display: agentctl classes   # how each tool's retries are made safe
steps.output:
open_pr              checkable
push_branch          checkable
comment_on_pr        idempotent
list_dir             local
run_tests            local
write_file           local
open_pr_naive        naive
read_review          read_only
delete_branch_prod   unsafe

steps.display: agentctl git ack-loss:pulls 1   # the Git host will lose its answer to the next pull request it opens
agentctl start --task '{... "naive_pr": true}'   # control: the agent uses a tool with no protection

steps.output:
step tool            class       status       attempts deduped  external
   4 push_branch     checkable   done                1       0  agent/s-2bb9151d-4
   5 open_pr_naive   naive       done                2       0  2

steps.display: agentctl start --task '{"ticket": "T-1", "test_seconds": 2}'   # the same task, protected tools
agentctl ledger s-f31e1eed   # attempts 2 and deduplicated 1: the retry found the work already done
steps.output:
step tool            class       status       attempts deduped  external
   4 push_branch     checkable   done                2       1  agent/s-f31e1eed-4
   5 open_pr         checkable   done                2       1  1
   9 comment_on_pr   idempotent  done                2       0  2

steps.display: # a production branch exists, and the agent has been given a tool that deletes it
steps.output: branch agent/s05-unsafe-4 created (1 branch on the Git host)
state=needs_attention  step=4  workflow=RUNNING  history_events=76  tokens=1352  attention='delete_branch_prod may have changed the world and cannot be checked'

step tool            class       status       attempts deduped  external
   4 delete_branch_prod unsafe      started             2       0  None

checks.description: control: the unprotected tool opened two pull requests for one decision
checks.because: The first request made the pull request but its answer was lost. The retry could not know, and made another.

checks.description: control: the ledger saw both attempts but had no way to stop the second
checks.because: A ledger only helps if the tool's class gives it a way to check.

checks.description: the run completed despite three lost answers
checks.because: Each lost answer was retried and each retry was made safe.

checks.description: one branch, one pull request and two comments exist (the reviewer's and the agent's)
checks.because: Nothing was duplicated, although each of the three changes was attempted twice.

checks.description: the branch and the pull request were found by looking first
checks.because: Checkable tools ask the outside world 'is it already there?' before repeating a change.

checks.description: the comment was deduplicated by the Git host, through the key
checks.because: The retry carried the same Idempotency-Key as the first attempt, because the key is built from the session and the step, not the attempt.

checks.description: the run stopped and asked for a person instead of repeating the delete
checks.because: The tool is classed 'unsafe': it cannot be keyed and cannot be looked up, so a second attempt after an unknown outcome is refused.

checks.description: it was attempted twice and not a third time
checks.because: The ledger counts attempts: the first made the change, the second was stopped before reaching the Git host.

checks.description: the delete did happen once, as the first attempt's lost answer suggested
checks.because: The platform cannot undo it, so it says what it knows and waits.

checks.description: a person ended the run and nothing else was changed
checks.because: Cancel runs the compensations for what the ledger shows was done, which here is nothing.
